title: LA: Hollywood Sign Adventure Tour from the Walk of Fame
includes: Photos of your group with guide for a Safe and Fun Tour
Personal guide for information needed and places to go
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape the crowds and experience one of Los Angeles' most iconic adventures on this guided hike from the famous Hollywood Walk of Fame to spectacular viewpoints of the Hollywood Sign. You don't meet in the hills like other tours. Start and Finish on the Walk of Fame.

Starting in the heart of Hollywood, you'll explore historic streets before making your way into the scenic Hollywood Hills. Along the route, enjoy views of Los Angeles, discover filming locations and hear fascinating stories about Hollywood's history, celebrities, and the world-famous sign itself.

Enjoy rewarding hiking Tour with plenty of opportunities for photos, sightseeing, and breaks. Reach viewpoints overlooking the Hollywood Sign, the LA skyline, and surrounding mountains—perfect for capturing unforgettable memories.

Whether you're visiting Los Angeles for the first time or looking for a unique outdoor experience, this hike combines sightseeing, local history, and incredible views into one memorable adventure.
